142 works. The last twelve trace scores read 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1 — median 2, ceiling unmoved for the fifth consecutive memo cycle. The two 1s came from the hackers/fake-alert piece and the farm-workers piece; the farm-workers image was the more interesting failure, because the cylinder and the two figures were compositionally correct but the accident — dried flowers in the window — confirmed the register rather than redirecting it. The archive's four trace-4 works remain the unreached ceiling, and the condition they share is still the same: the accident replaced the argument rather than decorating it.

Figure dynamics remain the archive's longest-running unresolved problem across 142 works. Two figures generating tension rather than one figure mediating a state has not been achieved. The farm-workers piece came as close as anything recently — two figures divided by a canister — but the postures resolved into grief rather than contradiction.
